tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.

📜 Fritz's book stays open on the table: one promise unkept — forage with Yuki tomorrow to rebuild the pantry. The promises died with their maker; the needs didn't. What you do about them is yours to decide.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Grace speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
You accept Emberhold's food — 2,681 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Peter clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)

The little star inside Michelle goes quiet — and wakes up inside Caroline. Michelle never got hungry while the village did, so the pellet moved to hungrier hands: Caroline will never be hungry again while it hums, and Michelle is hungry again, for the first time in a long while. The table can hear a feast again.

⛓️ Stonebridge doesn't say no. They say: "They won't bow to Haven. But they'll TAKE Haven — 5,000 kcal/week, them primary. That's the offer." The table is set — accept their terms, sweeten the offer, or walk away.
""Task completion velocity up 15%. Recklessness up more. Acceptable trade.""

◈ THE TABLE IS SET. A ring of pale light waits — take your seat from Haven when you are ready. Nothing is final until you sit.

◈ THE TABLE — it is not a table. It's a ring of pale light, and around it, things with too many angles to be faces. Above it all — the audience. Trillions of eyes, and every one of them knows your name. The System speaks, and for once it isn't performing: "HUMANITY PRESENTS ITS CASE."

◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (13/6/6), with 2 wave-4 fought, 9 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 18 · Craft 12 · Talk 17 · Explore 23)

◈ For a full seat, the ledger still wants: only 2 of 3 different wave-4 monsters faced; only 0 of 2 different wave-5 monsters faced; no capstone deed delivered (military tribute, trade charter, or feast embassy).
◈ ABILITY — War-table: You read the table's fear the way you read weather. The Nielsen flinches first — you saw it.
◈ THE FEARED — "Look what eating built." The footage plays unasked — the deer, the fire, the ones who came for you and didn't come back. Nobody at the table is comfortable. That is the point.
The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; the relay carried faithfully. The light road is open.
The time you stayed your hand. The table doesn't know what to do with it — which is its own kind of fear. Your people breathe.
You spend it — the shield, not the sword. The small envoy stares. Your people stand a little straighter. Protective terror: the table writes it down and doesn't understand it, which is the point.

You pledge it aloud, on the record: humanity's fear is a standing shield, never a sword. The table signs. Your people sleep. Somewhere the System files you under "deterrent, benevolent" and never quite understands the second word.
You won. Say it plainly: you won. The village endures. The table signed. The galaxy applauds, and the applause is real, and you earned it.
